# Transcription

**Document type:** Contractor quotation (1 page)

**Header (top right):** Quotation: Flat Entrance Door Surface Preparation and Painting
**Header (top left, small caps):** CONTRACTOR QUOTATION

**Contractor name:** Pale Finch Decorating

**Quotation reference:** NBL-017-Q1
**Date:** 7 February 2025
**Valid until:** 28 February 2025

**Site:** 14 Lantern Mews, Brindlewick, ZZ1 1ZZ
**Prepared for:** Northbridge Lettings

## Proposed work
- Protect the immediate work area on the flat side of the entrance door.
- Lightly sand loose coating on the flat-side face and visible top edge.
- Spot-fill minor surface marks and apply one undercoat and two finish coats of water-based interior paint to those areas.
- Remove work-area protection and leave the area tidy.

**Quotation total:** £186.00, including materials and labour.

## Assumptions and exclusions
Price assumes access during one visit and a sound, dry surface beneath the loose coating. Any additional substrate damage or preparation will be priced separately before proceeding.

This quotation covers surface preparation and decorative painting only. It excludes adjustment of the door, frame or hinges; removal or replacement of hardware; alterations to the door, frame, seals or threshold; and investigation of the door's construction or closing performance.

No door-set inspection, fire-performance test, certification, compliance assessment, or fire-safety opinion is included. No statement is made about the door's rating or suitability for any fire-safety purpose.

Work is subject to access being arranged by the client. No work has been scheduled.

*(The page has a decorative brown bar at the top and a thin horizontal rule near the bottom. There is no other text, signature, or logo.)*

---

# Unclear, missing or inconsistent

- **Contractor details missing:** There is no address, phone, email, company number, VAT number, or signatory for Pale Finch Decorating.
- **VAT not stated:** The £186.00 is described as "including materials and labour", but it does not say whether VAT is included or applicable.
- **No price breakdown:** There is no itemised labour or materials cost, and no payment terms.
- **No client contact:** Northbridge Lettings is named with no contact person, and there is no tenant or access contact.
- **Scope of the area is vague:** "The immediate work area" and "those areas" are not defined. There are no door dimensions, and it does not say which areas count as "minor surface marks".
- **Door not identified:** It does not state which flat or door (for example a unit number), the door type or material, or whether it is a fire door. The exclusions refer to the door's "rating" and fire-safety purposes without saying whether the door is rated.
- **Paint specification missing:** Only "water-based interior paint" is given. There is no brand, product or colour, and no statement of suitability for the door.
- **Scheduling:** No visit date is given. The quote states that no work has been scheduled and that access is to be arranged by the client.
- **Reference prefix:** "NBL" in NBL-017-Q1 may relate to Northbridge Lettings, but the document does not say so.
- **Line-break hyphens:** "water-based" and "fire-safety" are hyphenated across line breaks in the page image. I have transcribed them as single hyphenated words.

Dear Ms Vale,

Thank you for your update about the entrance door at 14 Lantern Mews (ref R/017). No work has been booked. We have a decorating quotation and are checking with the building manager whether painting is suitable for this door and whether the catching at the top needs looking at separately, before anything is arranged. We are not able to say yet whether painting would affect the door; we will confirm once we have heard back.

We will give you advance notice before any further visit, and keep to visits after 10:30. Meanwhile, please keep pulling the door fully shut so it latches each time. If it stops latching or you cannot secure it, please contact us straight away.

We will update you by 17 February.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
